heading: The whole community,
intro: Live streams, workshops and mutual help around Home Assistant: meet French-speaking smart home enthusiasts on video, in an instant.

header.brand: Home Assistant Communauté Francophone – HACF Meet, home

join.emptyError: Enter the room code from your invitation.
join.invalidError: Enter a link, a code (abc-defg-hij) or a room name: letters, digits and hyphens.

create.shareHint: Share this link: your guests join directly, no account needed.

roomName.label: Room name
roomName.hint: Random suggestion, editable: letters, digits and hyphens (e.g. atelier-zigbee).

errors.tooShort: The name must be at least 3 characters long.
errors.tooLong: The name must be at most 60 characters long.
errors.codeLike: A 10-character name without a hyphen looks like a room code: add a hyphen.
errors.unavailable: This name is reserved, choose another one.
errors.taken: This name is already used, choose another one.
errors.failed: The room could not be created. Try again.

invite.label: Invite by email
invite.hint: Separate addresses with a comma or a space. Each guest receives the room link without seeing the other addresses.

errors.empty: Enter at least one email address.
errors.rejected: The server rejected one or more addresses.
errors.failed: Sending failed. Try again later or share the link directly.

diagnostics.label: Diagnostics
diagnostics.title: Network diagnostics
